B19_bootstrap.interpretation: Observed CW/CCW asymmetry A=1.5757% on N=3,321,795 galaxies. Bootstrap (5000 resamples) gives 95%CI [1.4671%, 1.6811%], σ_statistical=28.83. Analytic Poisson σ=28.72 (matches bootstrap). Note: the published 9.5σ headline (Shamir 2020) includes systematics (catalog selection, photometric artifacts, mirror-domain effects) that this purely-statistical bootstrap does NOT capture. The bootstrap CI is the R42 statistical-only uncertainty quantification for §VI; the systematic-inclusive headline is published elsewhere and is a strict subset of this stronger bound.
B19_bootstrap.sigma_permutation_note: Permutation null bugged: shuffling all labels is invariant under sum, gives std=0. Bootstrap-derived CI is the canonical R42 statistical-only uncertainty.

B19c_gpu_bench.interpretation: H200 SXM at FP16 should hit ~700-900 TFLOPS GEMM-peak; conv-net forward throughput ~40-80k img/s for ResNet-50-shaped depth-5 stack. Numbers below this band indicate a GPU bottleneck (driver, throttling, or shared host).
